title: Iruka's Vanilla Enhanced
description: A vanilla modpack client designed to both join and be joined by completely unmodded players.
body:
A vanilla modpack client designed to both join and be joined by completely unmodded players with many client and server-only mods to enhance the vanilla experience to a modern standard. This pack does not add any mods or features that multiplayer anti-cheats might consider cheating, so you should be able to join and play on any server just fine!

[SEUS Renewed v1.0.1](https://sonicether.com/shaders/download/renewed-v1-0-1/) is my shaderpack of choice, but it cannot be included due to licensing. However, my settings for it are included should you add it yourself!

This pack uses Fabulously Optimized 4.5.0 as a base, and all of its protected content (such as icons, resourcepacks, and main menu changes) have been removed or altered to remove any association to them.
